aromagecananga.name: Aromage Cananga
aromagecananga.desc: While your LP is higher than your opponent's, face-up monsters your opponent controls lose 500 ATK and DEF. Once per turn, if you gain LP: Target 1 Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; return it to the hand.

beholdgateguardian.name: Behold, Gate Guardian!
beholdgateguardian.desc:
Activate this Skill during your Main Phase. Shuffle your entire hand into the Deck, then add 1 Level 11 monster from your Deck to your hand, and if you do, you can Special Summon up to 2 Level 7 monsters with different Attributes from your Deck and/or GY, but their ATK/DEF become 0, also their effects are negated. While you control "Gate Guardian", it gains the following effect.
● Once while face-up on the field, when this card is targeted for an attack: You can change the attacking monster's ATK to 0, until the end of the Damage Step.

berlineththefirestormvassal.name: Berlineth the Firestorm Vassal
berlineththefirestormvassal.desc: You can discard 1 card; Special Summon this card from your hand, also you cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn. If this card is Tributed for a Tribute Summon: You can look at your opponent's hand and banish 1 card from their hand until the End Phase. You can only use each effect of "Berlineth the Firestorm Vassal" once per turn.

carboneddon.name: Carboneddon
carboneddon.desc: If this card battles a FIRE monster, during damage calculation: This card gains 1000 ATK during damage calculation only. You can banish this card from your Graveyard; Special Summon, from your hand or Deck, 1 Level 7 or lower Dragon-Type Normal Monster in face-up Defense Position. You can only use this effect of "Carboneddon" once per turn.

darknephthys.name: Dark Nephthys
darknephthys.desc: If you have 3 or more DARK monsters in your Graveyard and this card in your hand: You can banish 2 of them from your Graveyard; send this card from your hand to the Graveyard. During your next Standby Phase after this card was sent to the Graveyard by this effect: Special Summon this card from the Graveyard. When this card is Special Summoned: Target 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy that target.

dracoonlamp.name: Dracoon Lamp
dracoonlamp.desc: Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can discard 1 Wyrm monster; this card gains 1000 DEF until the end of this turn. Once per battle, during damage calculation, if this Attack Position card battles an Attack Position monster (Quick Effect): You can apply each card's DEF for damage calculation.

dragonmaidnudyarl.name: Dragonmaid Nudyarl
dragonmaidnudyarl.desc:
Cannot be destroyed by card effects while you control a Fusion Monster. You can only use each of the following effects of "Dragonmaid Nudyarl" once per turn.
● You can discard this card, then target 1 monster in either GY; shuffle it into the Deck.
● At the end of the Battle Phase: You can return this card to the hand, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Level 2 "Dragonmaid" monster from your hand.

flashchargedragon.name: Flash Charge Dragon
flashchargedragon.desc:
2+ Dragon monsters
You cannot Summon/Set monsters to a zone this card points to. Once per turn, if a monster(s) is Normal or Special Summoned, to a zone(s) this card points to (except during the Damage Step): You can destroy 1 monster this card points to, and if you do, inflict 500 damage to your opponent. When a card or effect is activated that targets this face-up card (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 monster; negate the activation.

gishkiaquamirror.name: Gishki Aquamirror
gishkiaquamirror.desc: This card can be used to Ritual Summon any "Gishki" Ritual Monster. You must also Tribute monsters from the field or your hand whose total Levels equal the Level of the Ritual Monster you Ritual Summon. You can shuffle this card from the Graveyard into the Deck to target 1 "Gishki" Ritual Monster in your Graveyard; return that target to the hand.

gravekeepersstele.name: Gravekeeper's Stele
gravekeepersstele.desc: Target 2 "Gravekeeper's" monsters in your GY; add those targets to your hand. This effect cannot be negated by the effect of "Necrovalley".

guoglimspearoftheghoti.name: Guoglim, Spear of the Ghoti
guoglimspearoftheghoti.desc:
1 Fish Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
At the start of the Damage Step, if this card battles an opponent's monster: You can banish that opponent's monster. During your opponent's Standby Phase: You can banish this card, then, if the monsters used as material for this card's Synchro Summon are all in your GY, you can Special Summon all of them, but banish them when they leave the field. You can only use each effect of "Guoglim, Spear of the Ghoti" once per turn.

insectqueen.name: Insect Queen
insectqueen.desc: This card gains 200 ATK for each Insect monster on the field. Cannot declare an attack unless you Tribute 1 monster. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card destroyed an opponent's monster by battle this turn: Special Summon 1 "Insect Monster Token" (Insect/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 100/DEF 100) in Attack Position.

invokedaugoeides.name: Invoked Augoeides
invokedaugoeides.desc:
"Aleister the Invoker" + 1 Fusion Monster
If this card is Special Summoned, or a monster(s) is Special Summoned to your opponent's field: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy it. You can only use this effect of "Invoked Augoeides" once per turn. Once per turn: You can banish 1 Fusion Monster from your GY; this card gains ATK equal to that banished monster's ATK, until the end of your opponent's turn.

localizedtornado.name: Localized Tornado
localizedtornado.desc: Shuffle all cards from your hand and Graveyard into the Deck.

longtailedblackhorse.name: Long-Tailed Black Horse
longtailedblackhorse.desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can reveal 1 Zombie monster in your hand and send 1 EARTH Zombie monster from your Deck to the GY; send the revealed monster to the GY, and if you do, this card gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn. You can only use this effect of "Long-Tailed Black Horse" once per turn.

mixeroid.name: Mixeroid
mixeroid.desc: You can Tribute 1 Machine monster; Special Summon 1 non-WIND "roid" monster from your Deck. You can pay half your LP and banish any number of Machine monsters from your GY, including this card; Special Summon from your Extra Deck, 1 "roid" Fusion Monster with the same Level as the number of those banished monsters, ignoring its Summoning conditions, but destroy it during the End Phase. You can only use each effect of "Mixeroid" once per turn.

redrisingdragon.name: Red Rising Dragon
redrisingdragon.desc:
1 Fiend Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
When this card is Synchro Summoned: You can target 1 "Resonator" monster in your GY; Special Summon it. You cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck the turn you activate this effect, except DARK Dragon Synchro Monsters. During your Main Phase, except the turn this card was sent to the GY: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 2 Level 1 "Resonator" monsters in your GY; Special Summon both.

sasukesamurai4.name: Sasuke Samurai #4
sasukesamurai4.desc: If this card battles a monster, toss a coin and call heads or tails before damage calculation. If you call it right, destroy the opponent's monster with this effect.

scrapironsacredstatue.name: Scrap-Iron Sacred Statue
scrapironsacredstatue.desc: Target 1 of your Level 7 or 8 Dragon Synchro Monsters that is banished or in your GY; Special Summon it, but return it to the Extra Deck during the End Phase, also, after that, Set this card face-down instead of sending it to the GY. If this Set card in its owner's control is destroyed by an opponent's card effect: You can Special Summon 1 "Crimson Dragon" from your Extra Deck. You can only use each effect of "Scrap-Iron Sacred Statue" once per turn.

skystrikermaneuvervectorblast.name: Sky Striker Maneuver - Vector Blast
skystrikermaneuvervectorblast.desc: If you control no monsters in your Main Monster Zone: Each player sends the top 2 cards of their Deck to the GY (or as many as possible, if less than 2), then, if you sent at least 1 card to the GY, and have 3 or more Spells in your GY, you can shuffle all your opponent's monsters from the Extra Monster Zones into the Deck.

thegazeoftimaeus.name: The Gaze of Timaeus
thegazeoftimaeus.desc: Target 1 "Dark Magician" or "Dark Magician Girl" in your field or GY; Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck that mentions that monster as material, by shuffling it into the Deck as material (this is treated as a Fusion Summon with "The Eye of Timaeus"), but banish it during the End Phase of the next turn. You can only activate 1 "The Gaze of Timaeus" per turn.

urialordofsearingflames.name: Uria, Lord of Searing Flames
urialordofsearingflames.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by sending 3 face-up Traps you control to the GY. Gains 1000 ATK for each Continuous Trap in your GY. Once per turn: You can target 1 Set Spell/Trap your opponent controls; destroy that target. Neither player can activate Spell/Trap Cards in response to this effect's activation.

wallofrevealinglight.name: Wall of Revealing Light
wallofrevealinglight.desc: Activate by paying any multiple of 1000 Life Points. Monsters your opponent controls cannot attack if their ATK is less than or equal to the amount you paid.

xsaberurbellum.name: X-Saber Urbellum
xsaberurbellum.desc:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent while they have 4 or more cards in their hand, place 1 random card from their hand on top of their Deck.
